title: Immune cell map uncovers how individual aging trajectories diverge
summary_en: WashU Medicine researchers have discovered that the ratio between two types of white blood cells can predict whether a person stays healthy as they age or faces an increased risk of disease.
title_cn: Immune cell map uncovers how individual aging trajectories diverge

title: WashU seeks Carnegie Classification for Community Engagement
summary_en: WashU will assess its partnerships, teaching, research and service to the community in a quest to earn the Carnegie Classification for Community Engagement. A kickoff event is scheduled for Oct. 21 as part of WashU’s inaugural Community Engagement Week.
title_cn: WashU seeks Carnegie Classification for Community Engagement
